text:
Mouth of tears, your black pupils

call me,

claim me. Your lips

kiss me without you.

How could you have

the same dark gaze

with those eyes

you wear now!


You smiled. What silence,

what a want of merriment!

How I started searching for you

in your smile, head

of earth,

lips of sadness!


You don't cry, you wouldn't cry

even if you wanted to;

you have the dimmed face

of blind women.


You can laugh. I let you

laugh, though you can't.

translation.title: Mouth of Tears
